scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of global optimum; supplementary symbolic and numerical computational checks are not a substitute for its inequalities. Literature priority is provisional; no empirical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three instantaneous scalar observations, known frequency and stationary exponential covariance with no nugget, continuous scheduling within one period. Correlated stellar activity in practice need not be Ornstein–Uhlenbeck. No unknown covariance parameters, observation constraints, or marginal semi-amplitude precision objective.
title: Optimal three-epoch radial-velocity phase design under Ornstein–Uhlenbeck noise
